title: US, Ukraine and Russia hold first trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi
body:
On 23 January 2026, the United Arab Emirates Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced that trilateral talks among representatives of Russia, Ukraine and the United States had begun in Abu Dhabi. The meeting was scheduled to run for two days. UAE Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan welcomed the hosting of the talks and said he hoped they would lead to tangible steps toward ending a crisis that had persisted for nearly four years.

The delegations arrived one day after US President Donald Trump met Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky in Davos, and hours after US envoy Steve Witkoff held late-night talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in the Kremlin.

The Abu Dhabi meeting was described as the first in which representatives of all three countries sat down together since the start of the war in February 2022, which Russia launched under the name of a special military operation. Euromaidan Press later described the Abu Dhabi rounds, held on 23 and 24 January and on 4 and 5 February 2026, as ending without concrete agreements to halt the war.
